cohorts.title: Classification / B and D
cohorts.description: Held-out TRAIN, fixed snapshot and split (seed 42). Full search budget: 600 s search, 90 s per candidate, 1200 s per process, 4 Dask workers, at least 15 generations for acceptance. No official TEST or legacy-table comparison.
cohorts.unit_description: Same dataset and search seed for each pair. Seeds are repeats on a fixed split, not independent datasets.

cohorts.title: Regression / B and D
cohorts.description: Held-out TRAIN, fixed snapshot and split (seed 42). Full search budget: 600 s search, 90 s per candidate, 1200 s per process, 4 Dask workers, at least 15 generations for acceptance. Scores from incomplete searches are diagnostic only.
cohorts.unit_description: Same dataset and search seed for each pair. RMSE scales differ between datasets.

cohorts.title: Forecasting / B and D
cohorts.description: Held-out TRAIN tails, horizon 12, one representative series per scenario. Full search budget: 600 s search, 90 s per candidate, 1200 s per process, 4 Dask workers, at least 15 generations for acceptance. Not an official M4 or Monash run.
cohorts.unit_description: Same series and search seed for each pair. RMSE scales differ between series.

cohorts.title: Forecasting / TIME frozen weights
cohorts.description: TIME-ProcessedCSV 683bb21b470f5a26586e1ab2295f0a2a1529ef0f, one monthly series, five windows of 12 months. CPU, one Torch thread, frozen Chronos; possible training-data overlap is unknown.
cohorts.unit_description: Forecast origin, one score per model and window. Windows on one underlying series are not independent datasets.

cohorts.title: Anomaly detection / NAB
cohorts.description: NAB ea702d75cc2258d9d7dd35ca8e5e2539d71f3140, one stream, absolute differences and P99 threshold fixed on the first 1090 observations. 53 false alerts over 6766 calendar hours; not the composite NAB Score.
cohorts.unit_description: One stream, no repeat or model comparison.
